text:
support_tina: Hi team — SME customer PaperTrail (acct PT-431) reporting autopay failure for invoice INV-2026-03-15. Charge $1,200 attempted, card ending 6812. Merchant sees 'declined' in portal, reason shows both 'insufficient_funds' and a subsequent fraud soft-decline. Customer wants a retry and explanation.

merchant_alex: Yep — customer confirmed bank pop-up tried to show 3DS challenge but it looked like it never loaded and then the charge failed. They don't want multiple retries hitting the cardholder.

payments-bot: webhook received: event_id=evt_8f2b9ac, status=declined, decline_code=insufficient_funds, acquirer_code=51, attempts=1

gateway-bot: acquirer_raw_response: {"status":"DECLINED","reason_code":"51","reason":"Insufficient funds","risk_flag":"MEDIUM","acs":"challenge_required","acs_status":"timeout"}

eng_raj: Thanks — can you paste the provider_event_id and the raw response JSON from our gateway for the three attempts? Also which PSP (acquirer) is this tied to?

support_tina: provider_event_id=evt_8f2b9ac, acquirer=FirstClearPay. Raw response (sanitized):
```
{
  "event":"authorization_response",
  "provider_id":"evt_8f2b9ac",
  "acquirer":"firstclearpay",
  "auth":{
    "code":"51",
    "message":"Insufficient funds",
    "risk_score":62,
    "fraud_action":"soft_decline"
  },
  "3ds":{
    "acs_url":"https://acs.firstclearpay/txn/abcd",
    "acs_result":null,
    "acs_status":"timeout",
    "challenge_attempts":1
  }
}
```

cs_maya: Merchant says the iframe for the 3DS challenge never rendered for the cardholder — they did see a spinner for ~15s then nothing. Could be ACS slow or client-side CSP blocking iframe. Merchant is on a hosted-payments iframe.

eng_raj: Noted. From our logs I see the 3DS flow timed out after 30s and acquirer returned a soft fraud decline on fallback. That explains both 'insufficient funds' and the fraud flag — acquirer uses fallback to do risk checks.

ops_jon: Quick triage steps: 1) Ask merchant to confirm CSP and iframe settings, 2) ask cardholder to try alternate card, 3) if merchant prefers, we can schedule a retry but recommend manual / different funding source. Our auto-retry policy is 3 attempts at 1h, 6h, 24h by default.

support_tina: Merchant gave permission to share logs with acquirer and wants us to try a single immediate retry before auto-retries. They want escalation if this repeats.

payments_chris: I'm taking this on. I'll ping FirstClearPay and share the acquirer_raw_response + timestamp window. Can you confirm timezone of the attempt? (we got 2026-03-15T18:12:07Z). Also, any frontend console errors from their hosted iframe?

merchant_alex: They have one screenshot showing an empty iframe and console error 'Refused to display https://acs.firstclearpay in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'sameorigin''.

eng_raj: That X-Frame-Options is a red flag — ACS should not send sameorigin if loaded cross-site. Could be acquirer misconfiguration. If the ACS blocks rendering, challenge can't complete -> timeout -> fallback -> decline.

payments_chris: Ok forwarding to acquirer ops and asking them to check ACS headers. Meanwhile, we can attempt a manual retry using a vault token (merchant approved). Re-run charge with parameter allow_3ds=true so we force challenge flow again.

support_tina: Manual retry command (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/charges \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-03-15","amount":120000,"currency":"usd","card_token":"card_tok_7yZ","capture":true,"force_3ds":true}'
```

payments-bot: manual charge queued: job_id=job_91b, attempts=1, queued_by=support_tina

gateway-bot: job_91b result: DECLINED -> acquirer_response:{"code":"R01","message":"Insufficient funds"}, 3DS attempt: challenge initiated, acs_result: failed_to_render (X-Frame-Options).

eng_raj: So manual retry produced same external outcome — ACS refusing to frame. Short-term mitigation: recommend merchant switch hosted iframe mode to redirect-to-acs (popup/redirect) or ask acquirer to fix ACS headers. Long-term: add a policy to detect 'acs failed_to_render' and automatically surface clearer merchant-visible error + skip further retries until merchant confirms ACS fix.

ops_jon: Agree — I'll open an internal ticket to add clearer error classification and pause retries for 'acs_render_failure' cases. Tagging payments and devex.

payments_chris: I've escalated to FirstClearPay ops. They'll check why ACS sends X-Frame-Options:sameorigin for cross-origin loads. If they confirm a transient misconfig, we should retry once after they fix. I'll update here when they respond.

support_tina: Merchant wants immediate next steps to keep customer happy — suggested: invoice manual pay link + advise end-customer to try a different card or bank. Merchant accepted, sent manual link.

merchant_alex: Thanks — we'll pause auto-retries and take manual payment for this invoice. Please notify when acquirer confirms.

payments_chris: Logged follow-up: ticket PAY-8743 -> assigned to acquirer-team. If acquirer can't fix within 48h, we will propose alternative routing to another acquiring partner for that merchant.

support_tina: Closing thread for now; will reopen if acquirer confirms fix or merchant reports more failures. :white_check_mark:
